headline: Advanced changes to student discipline, immunization, and health screening policies for second reading.
summary: Several policies were revised to match 2026 state public acts. One change limits suspensions for students in preschool through second grade to cases of serious physical harm. A related regulation needed no changes and will not move forward.
decisions: Referred revisions to Policy 5131, Student Discipline, to the full board for second read.
Referred revisions to Policy 5141.3, Health Assessments and Screenings, to the full board for second read.
Referred revisions to Policy 5131.311, Immunizations, to the full board for second read.
Referred revisions to Policy 4152.6/4252.6, Family Medical Leave Act, to the full board for second read.
Referred revisions to Bylaw 9311, Board Policies, to the full board for second read.
Regulation 5131a, Administrative Regulations Regarding Student Discipline, will not move forward for further action.
Referred revisions to Regulation 5145.4a, on students and Section 504, to the full board for second read.
